selection: Every TypeScript original whole-program parent from the uniformly selected all-17 round22 cohort. No native prefix outcomes or semantic labels are read.
hypothesis: The earlier type-directed observation projection recovered valid executable tests in a small emitted sample. Apply the same rule to a uniform source-ranked parent cohort before prefix truncation.
method: paired compiler diagnostics -> remove only type-invalid pure observations -> verify emitted AST -> paired compiler recheck
tests: Seven focused transport and type-observer guard tests passed.
guards: Verify original and projected emitted full test ASTs.
Retain all input edits and effectful argument expressions.
Do not project if a new diagnostic affects an action or if no substantive observation remains.
Require a new paired compilation after each structural projection.
limitations: A TypeScript diagnostic can expose a subject type bug or invalid generated code; compiler success/failure is not oracle authority.
This phase measures construction only. Native execution and complete-test audit remain separate.
Only three trials use TypeScript; do not interpret this language component as coverage of all17.
